technique_name: List the causes of air pollution.
description: The main causes of air pollution are burning of fossil fuels, deforestation, agricultural activities, industrial activities, atmospheric reactions, and transportation. Burning of fossil fuels produces carbon dioxide, which is a green house gas, as well as other pollutants such as nitrogen oxides, sulfur dioxide, and particulate matter.
